<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/create_node_template/{project_guid}/{workflow_guid}/{node_guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Copies an existing node's config (and script, if any) from the acting
user's dev clone into a new node template written to the project's hub,
under `templates/nodes/<node_type>/<slug>`, then commits and propagates
the change to every clone.
